lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Part 17 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan building his own car dealership. He travels to Moscow to learn from the most serious car flipper. Brisk, ironic narration; a little awe at Moscow City. Last line: a quick twist, then a confident, warm advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: No swearing. Line 1: determined. Line 2: honest, a bit lost. Line 3: curious, pointing at a photo.

leha.profile: Lyokha — the most serious car dealer in Moscow: bald, tattooed, leather jacket, drives a Rolls-Royce. Low, heavy, calm, unhurried voice; speaks in short confident sentences like a mentor; dry humor.
leha.notes: No swearing. Line 1: busy, cool. Line 2: teaching, slow and weighty. Line 3: brisk order, then 'Время пошло' with a smirk. Line 4: genuinely surprised, then decisive business offer. Line 5: amused, nostalgic, a little sly.
